name: Kashmir Women-only Winter Trip
difficulty: Winter sightseeing · walking and road conditions vary
season: December to February · winter conditions and access dependent
route: Srinagar · Dal Lake · Tangmarg · Gulmarg · Pampore · Pahalgam
description: A six-day women-only winter itinerary with two Gulmarg nights, Pahalgam time and a Srinagar finish.

itinerary.title: A gentle Srinagar welcome
itinerary.description: Arrive in Srinagar and meet your arranged transfer. Leave time to settle in, meet your fellow travellers and discuss the days ahead. A boulevard stroll or short shikara outing can be arranged when daylight and conditions suit; arrival time takes priority.
experiences: A shikara outing if selected in the quote
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Into Gulmarg’s winter landscape
itinerary.description: Travel through Tangmarg with a warm break before the final ascent. Check into your selected Gulmarg stay rather than combining the transfer with every snow activity. Spend the remaining daylight around lower paths suited to the weather and your walking comfort.
experiences: Time to settle into the mountain stay
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: A full day at your own pace
itinerary.description: Keep a whole day for Gulmarg. Choose a Gondola outing when the selected phase and tickets are available, or spend longer on gentle lower paths. Ski instruction, sledging and equipment are optional services to discuss with appropriate operators; participation is a personal choice.
places: Gondola boarding area, if tickets are confirmed
experiences: Optional beginner snow activities with operator terms agreed
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: From the mountains to the Lidder
itinerary.description: Leave early for the transfer to Pahalgam. A brief Pampore or Awantipora pause can fit around road conditions, without promising winter saffron flowers or harvest activity. Keep the evening quiet beside the Lidder after the drive.
places: Pampore or Awantipora on the selected route
experiences: A warm lunch break on the transfer
A short riverside walk if conditions allow
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam time and a Srinagar finish
itinerary.description: Choose a short riverside morning or one local valley excursion before returning to Srinagar. Aru and Betaab need a separate local-vehicle and access check; do not squeeze both into the transfer day. If time remains, discuss a focused bakery or craft stop in Srinagar.
places: Pahalgam or one selected valley outing
experiences: A group tea or craft visit by arrangement
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Until the next journey
itinerary.description: Keep the last morning centred on your transfer time. Have breakfast when flight timing permits, check that everyone has their belongings, and allow a generous traffic and airport buffer.
experiences: A relaxed breakfast when timing allows

extensions.title: One more Pahalgam valley day
extensions.description: Request two nights for a slower Pahalgam stay, choosing Aru or Betaab on separate outings rather than rushing both. This may change the main route; local transport, entry charges, hotel and extra cost are quoted separately.

extensions.title: Southern springs with an overnight
extensions.description: Discuss a separate Kokernag or Daksum-area night so the southern valley has its own time. The overnight base, road access, heating and return route need confirmation rather than being added to a busy transfer day.

extensions.title: Srinagar heritage, museum and craft time
extensions.description: Add a separate city day for Bait-ul-Meeras and one appointed carpet, weaving or traditional-art visit, or a focused shrine-and-market walk. Opening, worship, host participation and all fees must be confirmed.
